title: The Serious matter of the school
subtitle: 困难与应对 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）
meta: 主题语境：困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）　|　核心词汇：serious　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 serious 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 the keeper wrote of ① a serious matter of the school in the calendar, and everybody in the tower said at once that it was ② more serious than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the keeper, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the serious ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most serious matter of the school anybody in the tower had ever seen, or so the calendar for January 1956 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too serious to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the traveller who had come to help; the serious ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a serious look on his face, and said that no traveller in his right mind would call it ⑥ as serious as the look on his face they had once had in the old tower. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was serious or not, and he said so.

By 1969 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the calendar. What the line asked for was ⑦ something serious, and nothing besides. The traveller from the next tower called the whole plan ⑧ quite serious; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the calendar kept the names of the serious ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1972, at once, she wrote of another serious matter of the school in the same calendar, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ more serious than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most serious look on his face in the whole tower, she said in 1974, was the one she could never quite name; the serious ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 严肃（前置定语 a serious matter of the school：1962 年守夜人在年历里记下的那件严肃的重大问题）
B. adj. 严肃／严重（比较级 more serious than：文中两处，一处比学校的重大问题，一处比预想）
C. adj. 严肃／严重（最高级 the most serious：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 严肃（表语 too serious to do：母亲觉得它太严肃，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 严重（前置定语 a serious look on his face：叔叔把整件事称作一桩严重的神情）
F. adj. 严重（同级比较 as serious as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩他脸上严肃的神情相比）
G. adj. 严重（后置定语 something serious：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 严重（受程度副词修饰 quite serious：那位过路人的评价）

items.q: a serious matter of the school
the most serious matter of the school anybody
a serious look on his face
The most serious look on his face in

answers.why: serious 意为“严肃”，1962 年守夜人在年历里记下的是“一件严肃的重大问题”，此处作前置定语 a serious matter of the school。
serious 意为“严肃”，此处用比较级 more serious than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
serious 意为“严肃”，年历上 一月 那行字说它是钟楼里最严肃的一件，故用最高级 the most serious matter of the school。
serious 意为“严肃”，母亲认为这件东西“太严肃了，谁也用不上”，too serious to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
serious 意为“严重”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩严重的神情”，此处作前置定语 a serious look on his face。
serious 意为“严重”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩他脸上严肃的神情一样严重”，同级比较用 as serious as。
serious 意为“严重”，年历上那半行字要的是“严重的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something serious。
serious 意为“严重”，邻钟楼来的那位过路人认为这套计划“相当严重”，quite 修饰原级 serious。
serious 意为“严重”，1972 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要严重”，故用比较级 more serious than。
serious 意为“严重”，母亲 1974 年说的是“整个钟楼里最严重的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most serious look on his face。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1962 年，守夜人在年历里记下了一件严肃的重大问题。（a serious matter of the school）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更严肃。（more serious than …）
母亲觉得它太严肃，谁也用不上。（too serious to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩严重的神情。（a serious look on his face）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩他脸上严肃的神情一样严重。（as serious as …）
到了 1969 年，年历上只剩半行字：要的是一件严重的东西。（something serious）
answers: In 1962 the keeper wrote of a serious matter of the school in the calendar.
Everybody said it was more serious than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too serious to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a serious look on his face.
He said nobody would call it as serious as the look on his face they had once had.
By 1969 the calendar asked for nothing but something serious.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 serious 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1962 the keeper wrote of a serious matter of the school in the calendar, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most serious matter of the school in the tower, or so the calendar says.
My mother thought it too serious to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a serious look on his face, and nobody argued with him.
The traveller from the next tower called the plan quite serious, and everybody laughed.
The serious ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
